q: God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

s: Heman has daughters daughters of Heman (three daughters)
q: God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

s: Heman is a king's seer (in the words of God)
q: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn.

s: musicians' service is performed in God's house (song with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps)
q: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house

s: musicians' service is set apart by David (together with the captains of the army)
q: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun

s: Meshelemiah is a Korahite (doorkeeper division)
q: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

s: Meshelemiah has relatives count eighteen (valiant men, sons and brothers)
q: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

s: Obed-Edom has son Shemaiah (firstborn)
q: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn

s: Obed-Edom has son Jehozabad (second son)
q: Jehozabad the second

s: Obed-Edom has son Joah (third son)
q: Joah the third

s: Obed-Edom has son Sacar (fourth son)
q: Sacar the fourth

s: Obed-Edom has son Nethanel (fifth son)
q: Nethanel the fifth

s: Obed-Edom has son Ammiel (sixth son)
q: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth

s: Obed-Edom has son Issachar (seventh son)
q: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth

s: Obed-Edom has son Peullethai (eighth son)
q: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth

s: Obed-Edom blessed by God
q: for God blessed him.

s: Meshelemiah has father Kore
q: Meshelemiah the son of Kore

s: Obed-Edom has family size sixty-two (able men with sons and brothers)
q: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

s: Obed-Edom assigned lot southward (gate; sons got the storehouse)
q: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

s: Obed-Edom has grandson Othni (son of Shemaiah)
q: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad

s: Obed-Edom has grandson Rephael (son of Shemaiah)
q: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad

s: Obed-Edom has grandson Obed (son of Shemaiah)
q: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad

s: Obed-Edom has grandson Elzabad (son of Shemaiah)
q: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad

s: Hosah is a Merari (child of Merari)
q: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons

s: Hosah has son Shimri (chief, though not firstborn, appointed by his father)
q: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief)

s: Hosah has son Hilkiah (second son)
q: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth.

s: Meshelemiah has son Zechariah (son of Meshelemiah) (firstborn)
q: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn

s: Hosah has son Tebaliah (third son)
q: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth.

s: Hosah has son Zechariah (son of Hosah) (fourth son)
q: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth.

s: Hosah has relatives count thirteen (sons and brothers)
q: All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

s: Hosah assigned lot westward (with Shuppim, by the gate of Shallecheth)
q: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

s: doorkeepers has purpose ministering in the LORD's house
q: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

s: doorkeepers consists of Korahites (divisions)
q: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

s: doorkeepers consists of Merari (sons of Merari)
q: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

s: doorkeepers assigned by lot casting (small and great, by fathers' houses, for every gate)
q: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

s: doorkeepers has east gate staff six Levites (eastward)
q: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

s: doorkeepers has west staff four at the causeway, two at Parbar (westward)
q: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

s: Meshelemiah has son Jediael (second son)
q: Jediael the second

s: lot casting assigns east gate to Shelemiah (eastward)
q: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah.

s: lot casting assigns north gate to Zechariah (son of Meshelemiah) (wise counselor)
q: Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

s: Ahijah oversees treasuries (treasures of God's house and dedicated things)
q: Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

s: treasuries ruled by Shebuel (son of Gershom, son of Moses)
q: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

s: Shelomoth oversees dedicated things (with his brothers, all the treasuries)
q: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things

s: Shelomoth is descendant of Eliezer (son of Zichri's line)
q: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

s: dedicated things dedicated by David (with fathers' household heads and captains)
q: which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

s: Meshelemiah has son Zebadiah (third son)
q: Zebadiah the third

s: dedicated things has purpose repair of the LORD's house (from plunder won in battles)
q: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

s: dedicated things includes gifts of Samuel (under Shelomoth's hand)
q: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

s: Hashabiah is a Hebronites (oversaw Israel west of the Jordan)
q: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

s: Hashabiah oversees Israel (beyond the Jordan westward, with 1,700 men of valor)
q: Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward

s: Jerijah is a Hebronites (chief)
q: Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households.
